name: Klaus Richter
bio:
Klaus Richter's career began not on the racetrack, but in the server rooms of Vienna's largest tech firms. A meticulous eye for detail and an innate understanding of complex systems propelled him rapidly through the ranks. His transition to motorsport was a calculated risk, driven by a lifelong passion for Formula 1 and a belief that cutting-edge IT infrastructure could provide a decisive competitive edge. 

At Williams Racing, Klaus is known for his relentless pursuit of system optimization and his unwavering commitment to data security. He fosters a culture of continuous improvement within his team, constantly pushing the boundaries of what's possible with real-time data analysis and predictive modeling. His demanding nature is tempered by a genuine desire to mentor young talent and cultivate a collaborative environment.

physical.description: A stocky man with a focused gaze and a perpetually furrowed brow.

quirks: Always carries a multi-tool, even to meetings.
Insists on using a mechanical keyboard, regardless of noise complaints.
Has a whiteboard filled with complex flowcharts in his office.
